display_title: I'll Give You the First One!
description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=819716), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10584252)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003491)

Twenty-year-old So-Yoon, the pain of separation that came with graduating from high school is fleeting ! First college friends, seniors. First food, first place to visit. First love, first excitement. For all the firsts that I will write anew. So-Yoon's campus romance that is timid but says everything she wants to say !
